title: UX: show running indicator during runs
description: Add an obvious running indicator (spinner + elapsed time) during agent runs so users can tell it’s working even if output is slow.
notes:
Context: user can’t tell if a run is still executing once they hit Run (especially when output is slow).
Plan: show a visible running indicator (spinner + elapsed seconds) in the toolbar and within the output area when streaming hasn’t produced text yet.
Risks: minor UI/state changes; ensure Playwright tests still pass.
Tests: make all.
Failures: None.

title: Implement Gemini UX feedback (core)
description:
Context
- Apply Gemini review feedback to improve first-run and core interaction flow.
- Scope: renderer UX + settings; no IDE/VScode fork; keep simple.

Plan
1) Replace blocking alert()/prompt() with in-app modal + toast notifications.
2) Soften onboarding: no forced Settings modal; show welcome/CTA in main canvas.
3) Make plan review primary: show plan as central overlay when required.
4) Do not auto-switch workspace on file drop; treat drops as attachments.
5) Simplify Settings with tabs (General/Connection/Advanced).
6) Add inline API key verification.

Acceptance
- No native browser dialogs are used for app flow.
- Fresh install with no key shows friendly onboarding and clear action to set key.
- Planning requires explicit review in a prominent UI before execution.
- Dropping a file never changes the configured workspace automatically.
- Settings are split into clear sections.
- API key can be verified from Settings with a clear success/failure indicator.

Risks
- Electron IPC changes must remain secure (do not log secrets).
- Network call for key verification must be lightweight and handle failures.

Tests
- Run `make all`.

title: Improve Codex Desktop UX + workspace workflow
description: Goals: make Codex Desktop actually run Codex (not stub), improve onboarding (API key + config), add workspace folder selection, surface model override + sandbox mode for performance/safety, improve streaming/progress UX, and harden packaged builds. Audit: main builds CJS so ESM @openai/codex-sdk import fails -> stub; no settings UI for API key/config; dev .env path mismatch vs README; pickCwd IPC unused; runTask uses non-existent runStream; packaged asar likely blocks executing codex binary without unpack/path override.
notes:
Implemented Settings (API key, workspace folder, output folder, model override, sandbox mode, include file contents), added toolbar + improved Save As UX, wired real Codex execution via ESM-safe dynamic import + runStreamed streaming, and now embeds dropped file contents into the effective prompt when enabled. Hardened packaging (asarUnpack for codex binary), added interface contract Makefile + .agents.yml, and un-ignored/tracked codex-desktop/config/.env.example for onboarding.

Tests: AGENT_MODE=baseline make setup; AGENT_MODE=baseline make all (Playwright: 4 passed).
close_reason: Implemented + validated; see notes for commands.

title: UX: simplify plan/run flow + declutter UI
description: Make first-run UX clearer: focus command input on launch, avoid blank plan drawer, reduce button clutter, rename settings labels (Default model/Permissions), default workspace folder to Downloads, and make the plan→run flow obvious (Preview plan → Run).
notes:
Context: packaged app felt cluttered and confusing (Run only previewed plan; many buttons; chips row; workspace chooser always visible). Requested: show command bar immediately, default workspace to Downloads, rename Model override→Default model, Sandbox mode→Permissions, and hide Codex config for now.
Plan: simplify primary action (Preview plan → Run), collapse plan drawer until needed, declutter toolbar/footer, update settings labels, then update Playwright tests and run interface gates.
Risks: changed UI labels + flow; requires updating tests.
Tests: make all (tsc + vite build + Playwright).
Failures: None.

title: Onboarding: prompt for API key + app-managed Codex config
description: Follow-up: on fresh install, app should proactively ask for API key, create/manage Codex config internally (no manual copying), and default to latest GPT-5.2 model (verify online). Also run packaging builds, clean temp files, and update GitHub via PR.
notes:
Implemented first-run onboarding and self-contained config so a fresh install can just run after entering a key:
- Auto-opens Settings when no key; blocks Accept until key is present (unless CODEX_DESKTOP_FORCE_STUB=1).
- Defaults modelOverride to gpt-5.2 (verified via /v1/models: gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.2-2025-12-11 available).
- Uses app-managed CODEX_HOME under userData/codex by default; creates a minimal config.toml; Settings can switch to global config or import from ~/.codex.
- Packaged build: electron-builder asarUnpack for codex-sdk vendor binary; verified codex binary present under app.asar.unpacked.

Validation:
- AGENT_MODE=baseline make all (Playwright: 4 passed)
- cd codex-desktop && npm run build:mac (DMG builds)

Shipped via PR #1 on GitHub.
